seoTitle: Value Proposition Generator: Canvas to Statement
metaDescription: Turn customer jobs, pains and gains plus your product benefits into value proposition statements using fill-in patterns. Free and private.
intro: Fill in the canvas fields and get a fill-in sentence, a positioning statement and headline options.
why:
Many value propositions are vague. Forcing the pieces into a pattern - who it is for, the job, the pain, how you relieve it - shows which piece you cannot yet say clearly.

The patterns are the common fill-in and positioning templates. The output is a draft to edit, not finished copy. Check that it names a real customer and could not be claimed by every competitor.
howTo: Describe the customer and their job, pain and gain.
Add your product, category and how it relieves the pain.
Edit and test the wording with real customers.

faq.q: Where do the patterns come from?
faq.a: They are the widely used fill-in and positioning statement patterns.
